podcast.title: 1963 Recordings
podcast.body: Johnny Sandin made some records with The VMO4 in 1963, but these did not achieve success. "Sandin made some records with the VMO4 in 1963, but they went nowhere."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 113: "Needles and Pins" by The Searchers

podcast.title: Backed Tommy Quickly
podcast.body: The VMO4 later went on to back Tommy Quickly. "The VMO4 later moved on to back Tommy quickly, who we heard last week singing a song The Beatles wrote for him."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 113: "Needles and Pins" by The Searchers

podcast.title: Managed by Brian Epstein
podcast.body: The VMO4 was a group managed by Brian Epstein. "Sandin quit the group to join the VMO4, a group that was managed by Brian Epstein."
